assumptions.title: Provisional boundary and control data
assumptions.statement: Overall boundary, key-area extents, current traffic, cadastral, utility, fire, property and statutory controls are not fully available in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All alignments, areas and phases are conceptual; recalculate when cleared official geometry and controls are supplied.

assumptions.title: Low-speed human-supervised operation
assumptions.statement: Robots yield to pedestrians, operate at low speed and can be stopped or taken over by a human.
assumptions.impact: Requires operator, safety case, accessibility review and field trial before any deployment.

assumptions.title: Data minimisation
assumptions.statement: Only minimum event logs are retained; no personal data, raw video or audio is included in this package.
assumptions.impact: Requires privacy impact assessment and accountable data governance.

assumptions.title: Single-node pilot gate
assumptions.statement: Any future pilot is limited to a single node, a fixed off-peak window and human presence until accessibility, crowd, emergency-stop and accountability conditions are verified.
assumptions.impact: The loop length and five-node structure do not authorise operation; a recorded failure keeps the system at its current phase.

note: No assumption is an official planning, traffic, construction, investment or safety conclusion.
